evidenceNotes: HRD Korea identifies General Office for Labour and Welfare Service (GOLWS) as Mongolia's EPS sending agency.
The 11th Mongolia Point System route is Manufacturing, General CBT and Point System.
Registration ran 2026-03-25 through 2026-03-27; test announcement was 2026-04-30; test period was 2026-05-27 through 2026-06-26.
HRD Korea's generic information-office listing, cycle-specific reception listing and test-center listing are preserved in their own source contexts instead of silently merged.

HRD Korea's official candidate and final-result index rows both carry examNot=33, matching the direct 11th Manufacturing schedule: skills-candidate publication 2026-07-03 and final Point System result publication 2026-08-28.
A separate 2026 Special EPS-TOPIK route exists and is explicitly isolated from Regular 11th Manufacturing.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Use the current Mongolia notice for complete 11th-round eligibility. Generic HRD Korea EPS eligibility is preparation guidance only until locally cycle-specific conditions are verified.

stages.title: 11th Point System registration
stages.action: The 11th Mongolia Manufacturing Point System registration period was 2026-03-25 through 2026-03-27. The window is closed.

stages.title: Application / test fee
stages.action: KEP has not promoted an exact Mongolia 11th-round fee. Do not import a Special-route fee or generic HRD fee as a current Manufacturing exact rule.

stages.title: Identity verification
stages.action: Follow only current Mongolia identity/anti-fraud requirements. KEP does not copy another country's biometric steps.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: The exact 11th-round passport/photo/upload/payment checklist is not yet reconstructed in KEP. Do not substitute another country's or Special-route checklist.

stages.title: Test announcement / admission
stages.action: HRD Korea records the 11th Mongolia Manufacturing test announcement date as 2026-04-30. Use the official notice for individual test/admission details.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — 11th Point System
stages.action: The 11th Mongolia Manufacturing route is General CBT with Point System. HRD Korea records the test period as 2026-05-27 through 2026-06-26.

stages.title: Skills Test — Round 2
stages.action: HRD Korea's official skills-candidate index row for Mongolia carries examNot=33, exactly matching the 11th Manufacturing schedule, and was published 2026-07-03.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: HRD Korea's official final-result row carries examNot=33, exactly matching the 11th Manufacturing schedule, and was published 2026-08-28. Final test selection still does not guarantee employer selection.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Mongolia psychology stage is asserted from the verified sources. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Use only current Mongolia EPS medical/provider guidance. Exact 11th-round provider, checklist and fee remain HOLD.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: After verified final selection, follow current Mongolia candidate-file instructions. Exact 11th-round documents and timing remain HOLD.

stages.title: EPS Job Seekers' Roster
stages.action: Only officially qualified candidates proceed to employer selection. Private intermediaries cannot guarantee roster priority or placement.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for selection through the official EPS system. No private intermediary can guarantee a specific Korean employer.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected, follow the current official Mongolia/EPS instructions for SLC review/signing and next steps.

stages.title: Post-SLC Mongolia requirements
stages.action: Follow current official instructions for medical follow-up, training, visa documents, payments and departure preparation.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current Mongolia/Korean-mission visa checklist and fees. Exact current 11th-round downstream details are not yet mapped.

stages.title: Pre-departure training
stages.action: Complete only the official pre-departure training assigned to selected Korea-bound workers. Exact timing/location/fee remain current-notice specific.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: Do not invent an Indonesia-style MCU-III stage. Follow current Mongolia instructions only if a final health recheck is explicitly required.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only after official contract, visa, training and departure requirements are complete and the official departure process is issued.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.
